lede: Wednesday is the heaviest day on the calendar — the BOCC sits as the Housing Authority to take up regional affordable housing compliance procedures, while Telluride's P&Z gets its first formal look at a school district employee housing proposal on the high school site, and HARC reviews the Shandoka Lot redevelopment at 860 Black Bear Rd. Ouray County's Planning Commission also holds three public hearings Wednesday, including a proposed repeal of an entire section of the county's land use code — the kind of change that tends to matter long after the meeting ends.
